title: Elon Musk Admits Mistake, Calls Anthropic the Current AI Leader | KuCoin
snippet: Elon Musk made a surprising reversal in AI + crypto news on July 9, 2026, admitting he was "clearly wrong" about Anthropic. He now calls the company the current
extractedText: Elon Musk publicly reversed his view of Anthropic on Thursday. He admitted he was “clearly wrong” about the AI company, calling it the current industry leader after months of harsh public criticism. Here is what Musk said, why it matters, and how his own Grok 4.5 launch fits the picture. Sponsored Sponsored What Musk Actually Said About Anthropic A public reversal is when a prominent figure openly contradicts an earlier stated position. Elon Musk did exactly that on X, writing, “I was clearly wrong about Anthropic. They are obviously currently the leader in AI.” His praise centered on Anthropic’s latest models. Musk added that no company has released a system as good as Mythos or Fable. Furthermore, he predicted the Claude maker would undoubtedly have Mythos 2 ready soon. Follow us on X to get the latest news as it happens. I was clearly wrong about Anthropic. They are obviously currently the leader in AI. No company has released a model as good as Mythos/Fable and they will undoubtedly have Mythos 2 ready soon. And I would never cut them off in a way that hurt them badly, even as a competitor.… — Elon Musk (@elonmusk) July 9, 2026 The comment marks a stunning shift in tone. Earlier this year, Musk repeatedly slammed Anthropic, branding it a hypocritical company and calling its Claude models “misanthropic and evil.” Sponsored Sponsored Moreover, in September 2025, he claimed: “winning was never in the set of possible outcomes for Anthropic.” Your AI hates Whites & Asians, especially Chinese, heterosexuals and men. This is misanthropic and evil. Fix it. Frankly, I don’t think there is anything you can do to escape the inevitable irony of Anthropic ending up being Misanthropic. You were doomed to this fate when you… — Elon Musk (@elonmusk) February 12, 2026 Despite the provocative comments, Musk also pledged restraint despite the rivalry. He wrote that he would never cut off Anthropic in a way that would hurt it badly, even as a competitor. “That’s not my style.” Why Did Musk Change His Mind Now The timing raises obvious questions, especially given the competitive and financial ties between the two companies. Musk’s reversal came just as his own AI venture pushed deeper into the model race. Those ties run deep through infrastructure. In May 2026, Anthropic signed a deal to lease compute from SpaceXAI’s Colossus 1 facility near Memphis. The company pays roughly $1.25 billion monthly for over 220,000 Nvidia GPUs through May 2029. SpaceXAI launched Grok 4.5 this week, positioning it as faster and cheaper than rivals. However, independent analysis ranked it as the “top non-Anthropic model.” Meanwhile, three Anthropic models remained ahead at the top of the list. SpaceXAI’s Grok 4.5 scores 54 to place fourth on the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index following only Fable 5, GPT-5.5, and Opus 4.8. It scores on par with GPT-5.5 in Codex on the Artificial Analysis Coding Agent Index in the Grok Build harness, at much lower costGrok 4.5… pic.twitter.com/YcnW7zXYhW — Artificial Analysis (@ArtificialAnlys) July 8, 2026 Musk himself acknowledged the capability gap. He later admitted that Grok 4.5 competes with an earlier generation of Claude, rather than the current flagship. As a result, his praise for Anthropic aligned with the independent benchmark results. Anthropic’s commercial momentum is also hard to ignore. The reversal reflects a broader industry reality. Even the fiercest rivals now struggle to dismiss Anthropic’s frontier position. Musk’s words suggest that the Claude maker currently sets the benchmark that every competitor in the AI sector must chase.
